hero.title: LET'S TALK
hero.subtitle: Have an idea? Let's build something extraordinary together.

faqData.q: What is your main area of expertise?
faqData.a: Enterprise infrastructure and systems administration — Windows Server, Linux (RHEL/Ubuntu), Active Directory, VMware/Hyper-V, and Microsoft 365 across hybrid environments. Alongside that, enterprise networking (Palo Alto, Dell SONiC, VLAN architecture), cybersecurity operations (SentinelOne, ManageEngine Log360, PKI), SQL Server administration, and PowerShell/Python automation.

faqData.q: What kind of role are you looking for?
faqData.a: IT Security Administrator, Infrastructure Engineer, or hybrid roles that combine core systems / networking / security with internal platform development. I'm most valuable in environments that want infrastructure operated as a product — with documentation, automation, and RBAC built in from day one.

faqData.q: What is your typical stack in production?
faqData.a: Windows Server 2016/2019/2022, Active Directory + Entra ID hybrid identity, VMware vSphere (HA/DRS) with 100+ VMs, Veeam for backup and DR, Palo Alto + Dell SONiC on the network side, SentinelOne + ManageEngine for security and monitoring, and Microsoft SQL Server backing internal apps. Automation via PowerShell (advanced) and Python. Internal tooling in FastAPI on Windows Server behind IIS.

faqData.q: Do you build internal tooling as well?
faqData.a: Yes. I build security and infrastructure tooling with automation, role-based access, databases, and auditable workflows. Public portfolio projects are standalone vendor-neutral concepts; employer systems and operational details remain private.

faqData.q: How can we start a conversation?
faqData.a: The fastest way is the contact form above, or email me directly at syedsrizwansr@gmail.com. LinkedIn (linkedin.com/in/rizwan-syed-79b798211) is also great for a quick intro. I usually respond within 24 hours.
